The spills, the sprints, and even the quiet snuggles. With smart designs and understated style, these are the diaper bag accessories and stroller accessories that show up when it counts… and look good doing it. Your Daily Sidekick: The Welland Diaper Tote Backpack Hands full? Of course, they are. That’s why this baby backpack is a multitasking master for moms. It can be worn two ways (tote or backpack), but we’re especially fond of the hands-free freedom. Bottles? Snacks? Your phone? It’s all right there in this caddy that snaps onto your stroller and stays put. Features You’ll Love: • Wide straps that securely attach to the stroller • Three sections and a slip pocket inside to keep everything right where you need it • Easy-access exterior pocket on the front • Wipe clean lining for those messy adventures From walks with baby to toddler trips to the park, this stroller caddy will level up your next trip out. Fast Changes, No Drama: The Welland Baby Changing Pad Clutch Your changing game just went pro. This space-saving changing pad clutch becomes a cushioned diaper change pad with everything you need tucked in convenient pockets. Features You’ll Love: • Mesh pocket for diapers, creams and more • Built-in zip pocket for baby wipes that make it easy to grab with one hand (Yes, that’s the feature you didn’t know you needed until now) • Easy-to-clean changing pad that tucks right inside when you’re done • Oh-so-chic style Soft fabric that keeps your little one happy with everything you need in easy reach? There isn’t much more you could ask for! Bottle Duty, Handled: The Welland Baby Bottle Bag This compact baby bottle bag is the must-have diaper bag accessory for parents who are always on the go. The insulated, food-safe lining keeps bottles ready to serve, and the buckle handle easily attaches to any diaper bag or stroller. It fits most 8 oz. bottles but we think it makes a pretty great place for an emergency snack stash, too. Pacifier Found: The Welland Baby Pacifier Holder Clean, close, and never lost again. This little zippered pacifier case with is the hero your diaper bag didn’t know it needed. Features You’ll Love: • Food-safe PEVA lining that’s easy to wipe clean • Zip closure so you know the pacifier stays tucked inside until you need it • Secure buckle makes it easy to clip on no matter what bag you're using "Perfect pacifier carrier. I can find it easily in my bag, it's beautiful green, and my pacifiers are fresh and clean." ~ Linda Relax knowing comfort is always within reach and no digging around in your purse is required. Snuggles on Standby: The Welland Baby Blanket Soft doesn’t even begin to cover it. This fleece baby blanket is light enough for year-round comfort but cozy enough to make every cuddle moment feel like magic. Features You’ll Love: • Playful pattern any baby will love • 100% polyester that’s gentle on delicate skin • Machine washable since we know messes will happen It’s the go-anywhere, never-without-it kind of soft. And yes, you’ll want one in adult size. Because You’ve Got Enough on Your Plate We’re not here to tell you how to parent. You’ve got your own rhythm, your own taste, and your own way of doing things. And that’s exactly why the Welland Baby Collection exists. This is functional baby gear for moms who trust their instincts and don’t have time for the extra fluff and fuss.
